setup.name: Create a project with one note

tests.name: opens a note from the explorer

steps.name: the note file has the new content

tests.name: pastes an image into the note

steps.name: paste a PNG from the clipboard (synthetic clipboard event)
steps.evaluate: (() => { const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob('iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8DwHwAFBQIAX8jx0gAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=='), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0)); const data = new DataTransfer(); data.items.add(new File([bytes], 'shot.png', { type: 'image/png' })); const target = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Note content"]'); return target.dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent('paste', { clipboardData: data, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })) === false; })()

steps.name: the note links the saved image
the image file was saved
args: const fs = require('fs'); const files = fs.readdirSync('.cutready/screenshots').filter((f) => /^pasted-\d+\.png$/.test(f)); if (files.length !== 1) { console.error('expected one pasted image, found ' + files.join(', ')); process.exit(1); }

tests.name: renames the note from its title

steps.name: watch the title blur (workaround: AR-29)
steps.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Note title"]'); window.__drillTitle = el; el.__drillBlurCalled = false; el.__drillFocusout = false; const blur = el.blur; el.blur = function () { el.__drillBlurCalled = true; return blur.call(this); }; el.addEventListener('focusout', () => { el.__drillFocusout = true; }, { once: true }); return 'watching'; })()

steps.name: Enter blurs the title; deliver focusout if the app window lacks OS focus (workaround: AR-29)
steps.expectValue: (() => { const el = window.__drillTitle; if (!el.__drillBlurCalled) return 'Enter did not blur the title'; if (!el.__drillFocusout) { el.__drillFocusout = true; el.dispatchEvent(new FocusEvent('focusout', { bubbles: true })); return 'blurred; dispatched focusout because the window lacks OS focus'; } return 'blurred; native focusout'; })()
